subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or narrow it to the already-open Track A and bug-specific reports?
rationale: Source evidence confirms real remaining gaps, but the proposed solution chooses ownership, liveness thresholds, SQLite durability, crash policy, and user-visible terminal behavior across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner direction and split Track A-D into small implementation PRs with proof gates.

options.title: Approve Track A Only
options.body: Use the open Track A PR as the near-term fix path and keep durability/completion-drive work in separate later design decisions.

options.title: Keep Reports Separate
options.body: Do not make this a canonical umbrella; continue resolving linked production reports independently.

recommendation.title: Adopt Staged Umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner direction and split Track A-D into small implementation PRs with proof gates.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus owns the umbrella proposal and opened the linked Track A candidate, making them the clearest owner for the canonical-or-narrow decision.
